essence: Cottagecore paladin baker. Put in the Enforcer Designate Pool at 01-399 for being large and frightening to look at, and incapable of harming a living soul — Maddy got her demoted out of it. She came out of that a hearthkeeper who bakes, and who runs heists in her own house as Sir Trashmuffin's ally.
open: V8 LOWER BODY, from her v7 profile as authored by Sera at the bar after closing, allegedly sober: SHRINE + RECOIL. Shrine mass — the largest, heaviest, most worship-commanding ass in the Found Family, altar-dome fullness over plush undercurve. Recoil motion — bratty snapback with visible return, every thrust absorbed and answered with interest, a clap engineered to keep the argument going. Exact Refinement: CHEEK PLUMP (OBSCENE). The v7 document reads Pronounced; Viraena corrected it upward on 7 September and Obscene is the word that replaced Extreme.

Thighs: garage-built pillars that brace against workbenches while the ass absorbs impact and returns it. Deep Arch into a high shelf. Four marks recorded: wrench-and-rose right forearm, gear on the left hip, garage-grade steel navel barbell, and a tiny S in Sera's handwriting behind the left ear.
Her enforcer number was 01-388, not 01-399 — the Archive recorded 399 from an earlier telling, which put her in a false collision with Akane. There was never a collision.
Discard number 10-044. Maddy's is 10-008 — both of them pushed into Flight 10, thirty-six numbers apart.
note: The SECOND paladin in this canon, after Gwen. They tried to make her a weapon and got a woman who feeds people. She is also the reason Banshee Haven is shaped the way it is.
